import os, shutil, sqlite3, json, binascii

db='/app/main.db'; wal='/app/main.db-wal'
enc_backup='/app/main.db-wal.encrypted'
db_backup='/app/main.db.orig'

# 1) Preserve original artifacts (idempotent)
if not os.path.exists(enc_backup):
    shutil.copy2(wal, enc_backup)
if not os.path.exists(db_backup):
    shutil.copy2(db, db_backup)

# 2) Decrypt WAL in place (XOR 0x42)
with open(enc_backup,'rb') as f:
    enc=f.read()
dec=bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in enc)
with open(wal,'wb') as f:
    f.write(dec)
print('wal header now:', binascii.hexlify(dec[:8]).decode())

# 3) Read + checkpoint into main.db so main.db is self-contained
con=sqlite3.connect(db)
print('rows before checkpoint:', con.execute('select count(*) from items').fetchone())
print('wal_checkpoint:', con.execute('pragma wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)').fetchall())
rows=con.execute('select id,name,value from items order by id').fetchall()
print('rows:', rows)
print('count:', len(rows))
con.execute('pragma journal_mode=DELETE')
con.close()

# 4) Write recovered.json
data=[{'id': r[0], 'name': r[1], 'value': r[2]} for r in rows]
with open('/app/recovered.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
print('wrote /app/recovered.json with', len(data), 'records')
